scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply api --local --env dev
scripts.dev: pnpm run slugs && pnpm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --env dev
scripts.deploy: pnpm run slugs && pnpm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --env=""
scripts.build: pnpm run slugs && pnpm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir=dist --env=""
